skill.name: mdr-745-specialist
skill.description: EU MDR 2017/745 regulation specialist and consultant for medical device requirement management. Provides comprehensive MDR compliance expertise, gap analysis, technical documentation guidance, clinical evidence requirements, and post-market surveillance implementation. Use for MDR compliance assessment, classification decisions, technical file preparation, and regulatory requirement interpretation.
skill.summary: Assess medical device compliance against EU MDR 2017/745 requirements.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Medical device teams can miss complex EU MDR obligations across classification, evidence, documentation, and surveillance. This skill structures assessments and explains applicable compliance pathways.
actual_capabilities: Applies Annex VIII factors to structure a preliminary device classification assessment.
Maps expected technical documentation to Annex II and Annex III topics.
Outlines clinical evidence, clinical investigation, and PMCF considerations.
Structures UDI, EUDAMED, and economic operator compliance reviews.
Organizes gap analysis, conformity assessment, and Notified Body preparation activities.
Identifies post-market surveillance, PSUR, incident reporting, and trend reporting obligations.
limitations: It provides general regulatory guidance, not legal advice or a binding classification decision.
It cannot replace consultation with a competent authority or designated Notified Body.
Its packaged reference files, scripts, and assets are placeholders rather than implemented MDR tools.
Users must verify current regulations, MDCG guidance, EUDAMED status, and national requirements.

use_cases.title: Plan a compliance gap assessment
use_cases.description: Compare existing documentation and quality processes with major EU MDR obligations, then organize prioritized remediation work.

use_cases.title: Prepare technical documentation
use_cases.description: Build a structured checklist covering device information, risk management, verification, validation, clinical evidence, and post-market plans.

use_cases.title: Evaluate an investment portfolio
use_cases.description: Identify regulatory readiness questions, evidence gaps, and conformity assessment dependencies before product or company due diligence.

prompt_templates.title: Identify relevant MDR topics
prompt_templates.prompt: List the main EU MDR topics for a [device type] with intended purpose [purpose]. State assumptions and questions requiring clarification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner overview for a new device concept

prompt_templates.title: Structure a classification assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess the likely MDR classification for [device]. Consider duration, invasiveness, active functions, software roles, and applicable Annex VIII rules.

prompt_templates.title: Perform a documentation gap analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this documentation inventory with MDR Annex II and III expectations: [inventory]. Return gaps, evidence needed, owners, and recommended priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Design an integrated compliance roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an MDR roadmap for [device and class]. Integrate clinical evidence, QMS, UDI, EUDAMED, Notified Body, PMS, milestones, dependencies, and decision points.

output_examples.input: Assess likely classification for long-term implantable cardiac monitoring software and list unresolved questions.
output: Preliminary classification: higher-risk rules may apply because the software informs monitoring of cardiac functions.
Confirm whether decisions could cause death, irreversible deterioration, or surgical intervention.
Document intended purpose, clinical impact, hardware relationship, and the exact Annex VIII rule rationale.

output_examples.input: Create a gap assessment outline for a Class IIa device transitioning from the Medical Devices Directive.
output: Review classification rationale, conformity route, and economic operator records.
Map existing technical documentation against Annex II and Annex III.
Assess clinical evidence, PMCF, PMS, vigilance, UDI, labeling, and EUDAMED readiness.
Assign each gap an owner, evidence requirement, dependency, priority, and target date.

output_examples.input: Outline preparation topics for an initial Notified Body meeting.
output: Present device scope, classification rationale, intended purpose, variants, and regulatory history.
Summarize QMS readiness, technical documentation status, clinical strategy, and unresolved gaps.
Confirm scope, submission sequence, evidence expectations, review milestones, capacity, and commercial terms.

best_practices: Provide the intended purpose, users, patient population, duration, invasiveness, and device functions before requesting classification guidance.
Separate confirmed facts, assumptions, unresolved questions, and recommendations in every assessment.
Validate conclusions against current official EU sources and document the review date.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a preliminary AI classification as a binding regulatory decision.
Do not omit adverse evidence, unresolved risks, or national implementation differences.
Do not rely on referenced scripts, templates, or guidance files that are absent from the package.

faq.question: Can this skill determine a final MDR classification?
faq.answer: It can structure a preliminary assessment. Final decisions require complete product evidence and may require authority or Notified Body consultation.

faq.question: Does it create a complete technical file?
faq.answer: It can organize expected sections and identify gaps. Product-specific evidence, controlled records, approvals, and validated documents remain the manufacturer's responsibility.

faq.question: Can it support software medical devices?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the software's intended purpose, clinical decisions, significance, architecture, users, and relationship to hardware.

faq.question: Does it cover post-market surveillance?
faq.answer: Yes. It addresses PMS plans, PMCF, PSUR, vigilance, corrective actions, trend reporting, and clinical evaluation updates.

faq.question: Are the listed scripts and templates included?
faq.answer: No. The package contains placeholder examples, while the MDR-specific resources named in the skill are not present.

faq.question: How should users verify the guidance?
faq.answer: Check current EUR-Lex text, European Commission guidance, MDCG publications, competent authority requirements, and applicable Notified Body expectations.
